title: How to Advertise Your Local Business on Facebook

facts.fact: The "store traffic" campaign objective in Facebook Ads Manager was previously labelled "local awareness."
facts.quote: Previously labelled “local awareness,” the “store traffic” campaign objective in Facebook Ads Manager can attract ideal customers to your business

facts.fact: The author recommends setting budget optimization at the campaign level rather than the ad set level for simplicity, which means the advertiser tells Facebook how much to spend per day.
facts.quote: For simplicity’s sake I suggest setting the budget optimization at the campaign level.
